digest.component_or_area: maintained documentation and docstrings for operation-certificate attestation
propositions: Maintained documentation outside approved file set still describes plan-review, completion-verifier, and verify-signature behavior as HMAC-based, contradicting the asymmetric DSSE/SSHSIG contract in ADR 0049 and hmac-opcert-removal.md.

Operation-certificate guidance must be corrected to identify DSSE, SSHSIG, Ed25519, and per-environment attribution, while preserving legacy HMAC readability, generic HMAC API docs, and historical records untouched.
Generated reference artifacts (mcp-reference.md, cli-reference.md) must be regenerated via canonical sources (gen_mcp_reference.py, gen_cli_reference.py) rather than edited directly.
Source docstrings in sign_manifest, verify_signature, and attest modules must be updated to reflect current asymmetric op-cert return shapes and verdicts, not legacy HMAC-SHA256 shapes.

All grep-verified HMAC references in candidate paths must classify as either generic-HMAC utility API, legacy-compatibility notation, or historical citation; no maintained current-gate statement shall describe HMAC as the active model.
